status_at_freeze: Before any new clipping-control fit; all previous optimizer-study results are already known
purpose: Complete every missing without-clipping partner in the two existing scored optimizer studies

fixed.scheduler: linear decay with optional linear warmup
fixed.loss: fit-only inverse-class weighted article A/B/C cross entropy
fixed.context: complete articles, at most 4096 article/4608 prompt tokens, reject overflow
fixed.checkpoint: final epoch only, no early stopping or development checkpoint selection

comparisons.sign: WITH clipping minus WITHOUT clipping; positive values favor clipping
comparisons.factorial: All 16 existing matched pairs, same fold 0, eight LR/decay/warmup settings and two seeds
comparisons.cv: Separately for baseline and candidate: pool all three held-out folds before F1 for each seed, then average three fixed seeds
comparisons.overlap: Four pairs are shared by the factorial and CV views; no combined grand mean or independent-sample count
comparisons.primary: Equal mean of DE macro-F1 and EN macro-F1; report DE, EN and JA separately
comparisons.sensitivity: Pool only folds 1+2, excluding the fold used for recipe selection
comparisons.uncertainty: 2000 paired semantic-group bootstrap draws, RNG 20261126; 2.5/97.5 percentiles conditional on the same fixed fits and seeds
comparisons.clipping_support: Positive mean primary delta AND positive primary delta in all three seeds AND conditional lower primary bound >0

scope: Scored Qwen-LoRA optimizer-study fits only. Full-Train deployment adapters have no held-out development set and are not counted as CV experiments. No other model family or historical study is retrained.
initialization: Fresh original pretrained base and fresh LoRA per fit; identical implementation/order to original validation; only clipping threshold is disabled
limits: Exploratory follow-up after all previous results were known, not a preregistered independent confirmation.
Same small Train set; folds and seeds are dependent. Bootstrap does not correct selection or all training uncertainty.
No new hyperparameter search; no final-Test inference; no accuracy claim for the saved full-Train adapters.
No automatic serving change and no inference that clipping must help.
